Method of Attack: Spam campaign pretending to be from 'WannaCry-Hack-Team' claiming WannaCry ransomware has returned
Threatens data deletion unless 0.1 bitcoins are sent to specified bitcoin addresses
Claims to have installed malware that encrypts and deletes data, spreads through local network, erases cloud-stored data, and freezes website operation
Uses email extortion with bitcoin payment demand and follow-up email contact
Attack Vector: Spam email with ransom demand and bitcoin payment instructions
Indicators of Compromise: Email subjects with misspelled 'Attantion' such as '!!!Attantion WannaCry!!!', 'WannaCry-Team Attantion!!!', 'Attantion WannaCry', 'WannaCry Attantion!', 'WannaCry-Team Attantion!!!'
